records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ines,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Welcome to Wrenfield -- excited to have North Labs here. If you get stuck on anything in the first few days, just reply to this email directly and it'll come straight to me.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 1 ([calendar:d7196452] call held), so there's real early momentum, but no invites sent and no customer reply to three Wrenfield emails ([email:33b8662e], [email:327fb36f], [email:9d9b78a9]) in 6 days suggests low engagement; 8 days remain, no tickets.

draft.subject: Quick hand with North Labs' next step
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks again for the welcome call last week — good to see North Labs already has a project up and running. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding the real work into that project is usually the next step that makes things click.

If it would help, you can also invite a teammate from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week work? I'm happy to look at how your project is structured and suggest where to go next.

Best,
Nadia
